newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock funds post redemptions in 2-day period.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock funds post redemptions in 2-day period.

text.p: U.S. equity funds recorded estimated industrywide redemptions of $1.62 billion for the two days ended April 28, compared to inflows of $708 million, according to a survey by Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
Bond funds posted outflows of $616 million compared to inflows of $617 million.
Among stock funds, aggressive growth funds had outflows of $1.18 billion versus inflows of $371 million, while growth funds had outflows of $877 million versus inflows of $60 million.
The fund tracking firm reported international stock funds had outflows of $273 million versus inflows of $609 million.

Among bond funds, flexible/balanced/mixed had outflows of $544 million versus inflows of $753 million, while high yield inflows dropped to $57 million from $241 million. Muni funds outflows narrowed to $190 million from $506 million.
